description: This Kotlin source file defines the GameEngine class, which manages the game state for a local two-player Tic Tac Toe game. It handles the game board, player turns, game over conditions, scoring, and state serialization.

classes.name: GameEngine
classes.description: A class that manages the game state, board, scoring, and game logic for Tic Tac Toe.

methods.name: makeMove
methods.description: Attempts to perform a move at the specified row and column; returns true if successful.

methods.name: resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board for a new round, resets current player to 'X', and clears game over flag.

methods.name: getCell
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified cell on the board.

methods.name: getWinner
methods.description: Determines and returns the winner ('X', 'O'), draw ('D'), or ongoing (' ').

methods.name: toState
methods.description: Serializes the game state into a map for persistence.

methods.name: fromState
methods.description: Restores game state from a previously saved map.
